T:P1.1.text: Logistics Services and Freight Shipping | J.B. Hunt

T:P1.2.text: Our mode-neutral shipping solutions make moving freight easy. We're creating the most efficient transportation network in North America.

T:P1.3.text: Read our latest white paper: Structural Forces Reshaping the Freight Market

T:P1.4.text: Change the way you do business with the J.B. Hunt 360 °® platform. We're eliminating inefficiencies by creating one place for you to manage every step of the transportation process.

T:P1.6.text: Access to thousands of qualified carriers

T:P1.7.text: Take advantage of the cost-effective and sustainable solutions from North America’s leading intermodal provider.

T:P1.8.text: Move over-the-road shipments with flexibility and efficiency through our J.B. Hunt 360box® drop-and-hook solution.

T:P1.9.text: Receive access to nationwide reach, visibility into performance, streamline shipments and more with less-than-truckload (LTL).

T:P1.10.text: Get best-in-class safety, route planning and optimization capabilities for your dedicated fleet when you work with J.B. Hunt teams.

T:P1.11.text: We’ve got you covered from the first mile all the way through last-mile deliveries to homes and job sites.

T:P1.12.text: Get customized support, supply chain visibility and seamless transloading service with over-the-road and rail options available.

T:P1.13.text: Get a provider that creates a custom supply chain for your business and handles the day-to-day operations for you.

T:P1.14.text: Get the capacity you need for your over-the-road freight, supported by thousands of qualified third-party carriers.

T:P1.15.text: That's why we have a passionate pursuit of excellence and are always striving for more. We listen, innovate and invest in order to provide you with excellence. J.B. Hunt is driven for you.

T:P1.16.text: "Technology in the global transportation space to me means real-time visibility and the 360 platform does a very nice job of providing that for me."

T:P1.17.text: Director of Global Transportation and Trade Compliance at a global fishing company

T:P1.18.text: "J.B. Hunt takes the time up front to really get to know our business, our pain points and then customize a tailored solution to meet those."

T:P2.1.text: Our Company | Creating Transportation Efficiency | J.B. Hunt

T:P2.2.text: J.B. Hunt provides a variety of freight transportation services to customers throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

T:P2.3.text: We got our start with five trucks, seven trailers and Mr. Hunt’s vision to create something big. We’ve grown a lot but our legacy of innovation and impact lives on. Together, we’re working toward our vision to create the most efficient transportation network in North America.

T:P2.4.text: "To get where we’re gonna go, it takes all of us. I can’t do it, you can’t do it, but we can do that."

T:P2.5.text: Our vision is to create the most efficient transportation network in North America. This statement keeps us focused on the future and what we’re aspiring for as a company. It encourages us to not only innovate solutions that make our company better, but to find ways to improve the greater supply chain.

C:P1.2.text: XPO is one of the largest providers of asset-based less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation shipping in North America. Get LTL Freight Quotes today.

C:P1.3.text: We're a leading LTL freight company with a world-class network, technology, and service. Our platform simplifies LTL shipping, offering instant freight quote options. Experience our network's power and get your LTL quote today!

C:P1.4.text: LTL Freight Shipping Is Mission-Critical to Your Business Operations

C:P1.6.text: So we put your freight first

C:P1.7.text: We’ve built a powerful LTL freight network with nationwide capacity, advanced technology, and a world-class team. We continue to improve and expand to deliver faster, smarter, and more reliable shipping solutions.

C:P1.8.text: We’re one of the largest LTL freight providers in North America, with coverage that spans the US, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean.

C:P1.9.text: We're growing to ensure we always say "yes" to customers, no matter how large the volume.

C:P1.10.text: Make your freight shipping more efficient and your experience simpler, with technology that works for you.

C:P1.17.text: "XPO's strengths lie in their ability to problem-solve. They proactively reached out to us, pointed something out in our data and told us how they'd be able to help. XPO put in the work ahead of time."

C:P2.2.text: XPO upholds unrivaled standards for our clients. Read about our safety, customer service and operational excellence here.

C:P2.4.text: XPO is a leading LTL carrier

C:P2.5.text: Our extensive network covers 99% of all US zip codes through a single source, plus Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean.

C:P2.6.text: Our proprietary software gives customers easy-to-use tools that streamline their experience. We use data science and machine learning to optimize for efficiency.

C:P2.7.text: We’re adding new terminals and expanding existing sites. We also build our own trailers in-house, and train new drivers at our 130 XPO driver school locations so we can quickly add capacity.
